players.name: Raleigh/Jeffers
players.summary: Ryan Jeffers (IL-10, fractured hamate) had surgery May 20; expected return 6-8 weeks. Twins using a committee at catcher.

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Harper went 3-for-4 with an RBI as Philadelphia blanked Cleveland 3-0. Zack Wheeler was dominant on the mound.

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: Arraez went 2-for-4 with two runs scored in San Francisco’s win over Chicago. His .347 season average leads the team.

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: Bichette went 0-for-4 in the Mets’ loss at Miami. Scouts have flagged a possible lingering PCL concern in his left knee; the Mets are monitoring.

players.name: Lindor/McGonigle
players.summary: Kevin McGonigle hit a solo homer (his 4th of the season) and scored in Detroit’s game at Baltimore. Impressive power from the 19-year-old.

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: PCA went 0-for-4 as the Cubs were shut out by Houston 3-0. Chicago was held in check all night by the Astros’ pitching.

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Merrill bounced back with a hit, a run, and a stolen base (SB No. 9) in San Diego’s win over Oakland — good to see him back after leaving the May 21 game with back tightness from a wall collision.

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: Teoscar had his biggest game of the season: 3-for-4 with a grand slam and 6 RBI as the Dodgers beat Milwaukee. A dominant night at the plate.

players.name: Stanton/Rice
players.summary: Ben Rice’s game (NYY vs BOS) was postponed due to rain. No stats for May 23.

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Williams did not appear as the Mets lost to Miami. He was held back for a save situation that never materialized.

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Wheeler was masterful: 6 IP, 2 H, 0 ER, 6 K, 1 BB in a 3-0 Phillies win over Cleveland. Win No. 5 drops his ERA to 1.60 on the season.

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: Ragans remains on the IL with left elbow impingement (out since May 8) and is on a Triple-A rehab assignment. No firm return date.

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Burns did not pitch in Cincinnati’s doubleheader (makeup of postponed Friday game). He is fully healthy — stated he’s “100% fine” after being hit by a line drive last week.

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Eovaldi threw 7 solid innings (5 H, 3 ER, 6 K) but took a no-decision as Texas won 5-3 at LA. ERA edges up to 3.65.

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Sheehan did not start; Roki Sasaki took the Dodgers’ rotation spot. His next scheduled turn is TBD.

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Detmers is scheduled to start Sunday, May 24, for the Angels vs. Texas. No outing on May 23.

injuries.name: Jackson Merrill
injuries.note: Active (returning from back strain, wall collision May 21)

injuries.name: Cole Ragans
injuries.note: IL-15 (left elbow impingement since May 8, Triple-A rehab)
